title: Dr. Jason Fung - 'The Aetiology of Obesity'
summary: Dr. Jason Fung, a nephrologist, presents his view of the causes of obesity and type 2 diabetes, focusing on hormones such as insulin rather than calories alone. The talk draws on research and his Intensive Dietary Management program.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a research-heavy introduction to how food type and hormones affect fat storage.

quote.text: Here's a good talk by a doctor, heavy on research, that's a decent introduction
